wording.hookAsk: Which Pixar or Disney animated film {hook}?

released.sort: from the earliest release to the most recent
released.era: Drop each animated film into the decade it was released.
released.shot: In what year did the animated film {label} come out?

kind.match: Match each animated film to the studio that made it.
kind.odd: Three of these animated films came from the {value} animation studio. Which one came from the other studio?
kind.all: Tap all {n} animated films that came from the {value} animation studio.
kind.reverse: Which of these animated films did {value} make?

rows.label: Cars
rows.description: 2006 American animated film directed by John Lasseter
rows.hook: follows a hotshot racing rookie stranded in a sleepy Route 66 town where talking vehicles live

rows.label: Toy Story
rows.description: 1995 animated film directed by John Lasseter
rows.hook: follows a cowboy doll whose place on a boy's bed is threatened by a flashy space ranger action figure

rows.label: Hoppers
rows.description: 2026 animated film directed by Daniel Chong

rows.label: The Lion King
rows.description: 1994 animated film directed by Roger Allers and Rob Minkoff
rows.hook: follows a young cub who flees his savannah home after his father's death and later returns to claim the throne

rows.label: Moana
rows.description: 2016 animated film directed by John Musker and Ron Clements
rows.hook: follows a Polynesian chief's daughter who sails across the ocean with a demigod to restore a stolen heart

rows.label: Coco
rows.description: 2017 animated film directed by Lee Unkrich and Adrian Molina
rows.hook: follows a Mexican boy who crosses into the Land of the Dead on a holiday honoring departed ancestors

rows.label: Ratatouille
rows.description: 2007 animated film directed by Brad Bird
rows.hook: follows a rat with a gifted nose who ends up cooking in a famous Paris restaurant

rows.label: Monsters, Inc.
rows.description: 2001 animated film directed by Pete Docter
rows.hook: follows a furry scare team whose power company runs on children's screams, until a little girl wanders in

rows.label: Frozen
rows.description: 2013 animated film directed by Chris Buck and Jennifer Lee
rows.hook: follows two royal sisters, one with icy powers she cannot control, and features the song Let It Go

rows.label: The Incredibles
rows.description: 2004 animated film directed by Brad Bird
rows.hook: follows a family of retired superheroes forced to hide their powers and live a quiet suburban life

rows.label: Beauty and the Beast
rows.description: 1991 animated film directed by Gary Trousdale and Kirk Wise
rows.hook: follows a bookish village girl who befriends a cursed prince in a castle full of talking furniture

rows.label: Aladdin
rows.description: 1992 animated film directed by John Musker and Ron Clements
rows.hook: follows a street thief who finds a magic lamp and a wisecracking blue genie in the city of Agrabah

rows.label: Finding Nemo
rows.description: 2003 animated film directed by Andrew Stanton
rows.hook: follows an anxious clownfish dad who crosses the ocean to rescue his son, aided by a forgetful blue tang

rows.label: Up
rows.description: 2009 animated film directed by Pete Docter
rows.hook: follows a grumpy widower who floats his house away on balloons to reach a South American waterfall

rows.label: Mulan
rows.description: 1998 animated film directed by Barry Cook and Tony Bancroft
rows.hook: follows a young woman who disguises herself as a man to take her father's place in the army

rows.label: WALL-E
rows.description: 2008 animated film directed by Andrew Stanton
rows.hook: follows a lonely trash-compacting robot who falls for a sleek probe robot and ends up saving humanity

rows.label: Encanto
rows.description: 2021 film directed by Jared Bush and Byron Howard
rows.hook: follows a Colombian family with magical gifts and features the song We Don't Talk About Bruno

rows.label: The Emperor's New Groove
rows.description: 2000 animated film directed by Mark Dindal
rows.hook: follows a selfish ruler who is turned into a llama and must rely on a peasant to get home

rows.label: A Bug's Life
rows.description: 1998 animated film directed by John Lasseter and Andrew Stanton
rows.hook: follows an inventive ant who recruits circus performers to defend his colony from grasshoppers

rows.label: Tangled
rows.description: 2010 animated film directed by Nathan Greno and Byron Howard
rows.hook: follows a long-haired princess locked in a tower who sets off with a thief to see the floating lanterns

rows.label: Atlantis: The Lost Empire
rows.description: 2001 animated film directed by Gary Trousdale and Kirk Wise
rows.hook: follows a young linguist who joins an expedition in a submarine to find a sunken civilization

rows.label: Hercules
rows.description: 1997 animated film directed by John Musker and Ron Clements
rows.hook: follows the son of Greek gods who trains with a satyr to become a true hero and battle the underworld lord

rows.label: The Princess and the Frog
rows.description: 2009 animated film directed by John Musker and Ron Clements
rows.hook: follows a hardworking New Orleans waitress who kisses a prince-turned-amphibian and shrinks into one herself

rows.label: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
rows.description: 1996 animated film directed by Gary Trousdale and Kirk Wise
rows.hook: follows a kind-hearted bell ringer hidden away in a Paris cathedral who longs to join the festival below

rows.label: The Little Mermaid
rows.description: 1989 animated film directed by John Musker and Ron Clements
rows.hook: follows a red-haired sea princess who trades her voice to a sea witch for a chance to walk on land

rows.label: Big Hero 6
rows.description: 2014 animated film directed by Don Hall and Chris Williams
rows.hook: follows a teen robotics prodigy and an inflatable healthcare robot who form a high-tech crime-fighting team

rows.label: Zootopia
rows.description: 2016 animated film directed by Byron Howard and Rich Moore
rows.hook: follows a rabbit police officer and a sly fox who team up to solve a case in a city of talking mammals

rows.label: Brave
rows.description: 2012 animated film
rows.hook: follows a Scottish princess and archer who defies tradition and ends up with a bear curse in the family

rows.label: Tarzan
rows.description: 1999 animated film directed by Kevin Lima and Chris Buck
rows.hook: follows a boy raised by gorillas in the African jungle, with songs by Phil Collins

rows.label: Treasure Planet
rows.description: 2002 animated film directed by John Musker and Ron Clements

rows.label: Lilo & Stitch
rows.description: 2002 animated film directed by Chris Sanders and Dean DeBlois
rows.hook: follows a lonely Hawaiian girl who adopts a blue alien experiment that she thinks is a strange dog

rows.label: Elemental
rows.description: 2023 American animated film directed by Peter Sohn
rows.hook: follows a fiery young woman and a watery man who fall in love in a city of fire, water, earth and air folk

rows.label: Incredibles 2
rows.description: 2018 animated film directed by Brad Bird
rows.hook: follows a dad staying home with the kids while mom fights crime, and a baby who reveals a wild range of powers

rows.label: Soul
rows.description: 2020 American computer-animated film
rows.hook: follows a jazz pianist who ends up in a realm where unborn personalities get ready for life on Earth

rows.label: Inside Out
rows.description: 2015 animated film directed by Pete Docter
rows.hook: follows a girl's personified feelings, led by Joy and Sadness, in her head after a big move

rows.label: Pocahontas
rows.description: 1995 animated film directed by Mike Gabriel and Eric Goldberg
rows.hook: follows a chief's daughter who befriends an English explorer and sings about colors of the wind

rows.label: Luca
rows.description: 2021 animated film directed by Enrico Casarosa
rows.hook: follows two sea monster boys who pass as humans on the Italian Riviera and dream of owning a scooter

rows.label: Fantasia
rows.description: 1940 animated film
rows.hook: features classical music paired with animated segments, including a sorcerer's apprentice played by a mouse

rows.label: Turning Red
rows.description: 2022 American animated film by Domee Shi
rows.hook: follows a Toronto teenager who turns into a giant red panda whenever she gets too emotional

rows.label: Elio
rows.description: 2025 animated film directed by Adrian Molina, Madeline Sharafian and Domee Shi

rows.label: The Good Dinosaur
rows.description: 2015 animated film directed by Peter Sohn
rows.hook: imagines the asteroid missed Earth and follows a timid young apatosaurus who befriends a human boy

rows.label: Meet the Robinsons
rows.description: 2007 animated film directed by Stephen J. Anderson
rows.hook: follows an orphaned boy inventor who is whisked to the future by a mysterious kid in a bowler hat

rows.label: One Hundred and One Dalmatians

rows.description: 2012 animated film directed by Rich Moore

rows.label: Wish
rows.description: 2023 animated film directed by Chris Buck and Fawn Veerasunthorn

rows.label: Finding Dory
rows.description: 2016 animated film directed by Andrew Stanton
rows.hook: follows a forgetful blue tang searching for her long-lost parents, with help from a grumpy octopus

rows.description: 2022 animated film by Angus MacLane

rows.label: Monsters University
rows.description: 2013 animated film directed by Dan Scanlon
rows.hook: follows two rivals at a scare college who are expelled and must cooperate to win a competition

rows.label: Onward
rows.description: 2020 film directed by Dan Scanlon

rows.label: Raya and the Last Dragon
rows.description: 2021 animated film directed by Don Hall and Carlos López Estrada
rows.hook: follows a warrior princess in a Southeast Asian-inspired land who hunts for the final mythical water spirit

rows.label: Sleeping Beauty
rows.description: 1959 American animated film
rows.hook: follows a princess cursed by the fairy Maleficent to fall into endless slumber after touching a spindle

rows.label: Dinosaur
rows.description: 2000 animated film directed by Ralph Zondag and Eric Leighton
rows.hook: mixes live-action backgrounds with computer-animated prehistoric creatures and follows an orphaned iguanodon

rows.label: Lady and the Tramp
rows.description: 1955 animated film by Hamilton Luske, Clyde Geronimi and Wilfred Jackson

rows.label: The Black Cauldron
rows.description: 1985 animated film directed by Ted Berman and Richard Rich
rows.hook: follows a young pigkeeper and a magical pig who must stop a horned king from raising an army of the dead

rows.label: A Goofy Movie
rows.description: 1995 animated film directed by Kevin Lima
rows.hook: follows a bumbling dad and his teenage son on a fishing road trip to meet a pop star

rows.label: Brother Bear
rows.description: 2003 animated film directed by Aaron Blaise and Robert Walker

rows.label: Ralph Breaks the Internet
rows.description: 2018 animated film directed by Rich Moore and Phil Johnston
rows.hook: follows an arcade villain and his pal who travel through the web to find a replacement part

rows.label: Oliver & Company
rows.description: 1988 animated film directed by George Scribner

rows.label: Chicken Little
rows.description: 2005 animated film directed by Mark Dindal
rows.hook: follows a small bird mocked after panicking that the sky is falling, who then faces a real alien invasion

rows.label: Bolt
rows.description: 2008 animated film directed by Chris Williams and Byron Howard
rows.hook: follows a canine TV star who thinks his superpowers are real and treks cross-country with a cat and a hamster

rows.label: Strange World
rows.description: 2022 animated film directed by Don Hall

rows.label: The Rescuers Down Under
rows.description: 1990 animated film directed by Hendel Butoy and Mike Gabriel

rows.label: The Great Mouse Detective
rows.description: 1986 animated film directed by John Musker, David Michener, Ron Clements and Burny Mattinson

rows.label: Home on the Range
rows.description: 2004 animated film directed by Will Finn and John Sanford

rows.label: Winnie the Pooh
rows.description: 2011 animated film directed by Stephen J. Anderson and Don Hall
rows.hook: sends the Hundred Acre Wood gang to rescue Christopher Robin from an imaginary culprit

rows.label: The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh
rows.description: 1977 animated film directed by Wolfgang Reitherman and John Lounsbery
rows.hook: bundles three classic shorts, including the Blustery Day, into one Hundred Acre Wood feature

rows.label: The Wild
rows.description: 2006 animated film by Steve Williams
